$comment: A fragment for an admin's managed-settings.json (macOS /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/, Linux /etc/claude-code/). tk never writes it (rules corner case 65); `tk connect claude-code --allowlist` prints it. enabledPlugins force-enables the tk plugin by its full plugin@marketplace id: without it, allowManagedHooksOnly blocks the plugin's hooks too. Replace the example server with your own entries. Read in Claude Code's managed settings and settings reference, 27 Oct 2026.
